A '''statue of [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]]''' was erected at the back of the [[Jedi Trials chamber|Jedi Trials Chamber]] within the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].

==History==
When [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] led the [[501st Legion/Legends|501st Legion]] to massacre the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]] during [[Operation: Knightfall/Legends|Operation: Knightfall]], the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] was partially destroyed. The [[Jedi Trials chamber|Jedi Trials Chamber]] remained damaged, but intact after the raid.

The [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] then constructed a massive [[Statuary|statue]] in the Trials Chamber at the behest of the [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]]&mdash;to show [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] superiority over the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] and how they conquered the Order.

===Destruction===
{{Main|Starkiller's Trial of Skill}}
[[Galen Marek]] was sent by his master&mdash;Darth Vader&mdash;to the Jedi Temple to continue his [[Sith training]]. He infiltrated the Temple eliminating the [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] that guarded the area and made his way to the Trials Chamber where he heard the disembodied voice of his father, [[Kento Marek]].

Upon entering the room the old Trials Program activated and the simulacrum of the [[Pau'an/Legends|Pau'an]] [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth Desolous]] stalked out of the shadows and engaged the apprentice in a duel. After an exhausting lightsaber fight, Starkiller used [[The Force/Legends|The Force]] to topple the statue of the Emperor which crushed Desolous to death.
